description: Check any wallet (EVM 0x address or Solana base58, case-sensitive) before paying it or taking its money: OFAC SDN list on both families; on Solana also the issuer freeze of USDC and EURC (Circle), USDT (Tether), PYUSD and USDG (Paxos) and USD1 (World Liberty), the issuer freeze index, and a fund trail up to three hops back. Returns verdict passed, blocked or unavailable, with each check. Paying an invoice (invoice_pay) runs this check on the receiving wallet and refuses with receiver_blocked, so a payment through Vurto Payments never reaches a sanctioned or frozen wallet. To pay someone directly, create an invoice to their wallet (invoice_create) and pay it with invoice_pay. Plain swaps (swap_build, double_build, nn_build) do not run it. Optional checks: ["scorechain"] also asks the Scorechain sanctions API; it sends the wallet to Scorechain, a third party, so it runs only when chosen, and has a tighter per-IP limit (10 per hour). Its line reads listed, clear or unavailable; unavailable does not hold the verdict.

checks.description: Optional extra checks; default none. "scorechain" sends this wallet to the Scorechain sanctions API and adds a scorechain line (listed, clear or unavailable). Runs only when chosen; limited to 10 per hour per IP. Any other value is refused with invalid_check.

wallet.description: The wallet to check. EVM 0x address, or Solana base58 (case-sensitive).

name: wallet_check
